title: Let Companion press buttons for you
goal: Turn on Accessibility for Companion (only used for Do it for me)

steps.say: Open System Settings from the Apple menu.
steps.find: the Apple menu at the top left of the screen

steps.say: Choose Privacy & Security in the list on the left.
Turn on the switch next to Companion.

instead.say: If Companion is not in the list, press the plus button under the list and pick Companion from Applications.
instead.find: the plus button under the list
